Find answers to the most common questions about our Dubai Desert Safari tours.

items.question: What is included in the Dubai Desert Safari package?
items.answer: All our standard safari packages include hotel pickup and drop-off in a luxury 4x4 Land Cruiser, thrilling dune bashing across red desert dunes, camel riding, sandboarding, unlimited refreshments (mineral water, Arabian tea, coffee), traditional henna painting, Tanoura dance, fire shows, and a lavish 5-star international BBQ dinner buffet with vegetarian and non-vegetarian selections.

items.question: What should I wear during the desert safari?
items.answer: We recommend comfortable, loose-fitting cotton clothing and sandals, flip-flops, or sneakers that you can easily dust off. Sunglasses, a sun hat, and sunscreen are essential for daytime. During the winter months (November to March), desert evenings can get cool, so carrying a light jacket or shawl is advisable.

items.question: Is dune bashing safe for children, pregnant women, and seniors?
items.answer: Safety is our number one priority. All vehicles are modern 4x4 SUVs fitted with protective roll cages and seat belts, inspected daily and driven by licensed desert safari experts. Dune bashing is not recommended for pregnant women or guests with neck or back conditions. For families with infants or seniors, we gladly offer direct gentle transit to the desert camp without aggressive dune bashing upon request.

items.question: What are the pickup and drop-off timings?
items.answer: For Evening Desert Safari, pickup is between 2:30 PM and 3:30 PM (depending on your hotel location in Dubai or Sharjah), and drop-off is around 9:00 PM to 9:30 PM. For Morning Safari, pickup is around 7:30 AM to 8:30 AM with return by 12:30 PM. Our team shares the driver details and precise pickup window via WhatsApp on the morning of your tour.

items.question: Are vegetarian, vegan, and Jain food options available?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! Our evening BBQ buffet features a wide variety of vegetarian and vegan delicacies including fresh salads, hummus, falafel, biryani, pasta, grilled paneer, dal, and warm naan breads. If you require special Jain meals or gluten-free food, simply inform us in advance when booking.

items.question: Can I drive a Quad Bike or Dune Buggy during the safari?
items.answer: Yes! We offer powerful 350cc - 400cc single and double Quad Bikes, as well as 1000cc Polaris Dune Buggies in an open desert track. Full safety gear (helmets, goggles) and an instructor briefing are provided before you ride. You can add this add-on directly when booking or request it at the desert meeting point.

items.question: How do I make a reservation and what payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: Booking is quick and hassle-free. You can reserve online through our website, WhatsApp (+100000000000), or by clicking 'Enquiry Now'. We accept all major Credit/Debit Cards, secure online payment links, Apple Pay, and cash payment directly to the driver upon pickup.

items.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
items.answer: We offer free cancellation and a 100% full refund up to 24 hours before your scheduled tour departure time. If you need to reschedule your date due to flight changes or personal plans, we accommodate date adjustments with zero penalty fees with 12 hours notice.

items.question: Can we book a Private VIP Safari vehicle or VIP Camp tent?
items.answer: Yes! We offer exclusive Private 4x4 Land Cruiser bookings for your family or group (up to 6 passengers). You can also upgrade to our VIP Air-Conditioned Lounges and VIP Table Service at the camp, where dinner and drinks are served directly to your private table with priority viewing of the stage performances.

items.question: Is photography allowed, and do you take sunset photo stops?
items.answer: Photography is encouraged and celebrated! Our safari captains stop at the highest dunes at golden hour sunset so you can capture breathtaking photos and videos against the Arabian desert backdrop. We also have traditional Arabic costume photo booths and falcon photography available at the camp.

items.question: What happens if there is bad weather or a sandstorm?
items.answer: Extreme desert weather is rare, but your safety is paramount. If local authorities advise against desert activities due to heavy rain or sandstorms, we will contact you immediately to reschedule for the next available day or provide a complete 100% refund.

morning-desert-safari.about_description: Start your day with an unforgettable Morning Desert Safari in Dubai, where golden dunes, thrilling adventures and breathtaking desert views come together for an incredible experience. Enjoy an action-packed tour with dune bashing, camel ride, sandboarding and more, perfect for adventure lovers and families.
highlights: Breathtaking views of the Arabian desert
Camel ride across the golden dunes
Photo stop at scenic desert locations
Perfect for families, couples and groups

faqs.question: What is included in the Morning Desert Safari package?
faqs.answer: Our Morning Desert Safari includes pickup and drop-off in a 4x4 vehicle, 45 minutes of exhilarating dune bashing, camel riding, sandboarding, photo stops at high dunes, and unlimited chilled bottled water and soft drinks.

faqs.question: What time does the tour start?
faqs.answer: Pickup begins between 8:00 AM and 8:30 AM depending on your hotel or residence location in Dubai. The entire tour lasts approximately 4 hours, returning by 12:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is hotel pick-up and drop-off included?
faqs.answer: Yes! Complimentary hotel pickup and drop-off is included from any hotel, residence, or airport terminal in Dubai and Sharjah.

faqs.question: Can children participate in the desert safari?
faqs.answer: Yes, children of all ages are welcome! Child safety seats are available upon advance request for maximum safety and comfort.

faqs.question: What should I wear for the tour?
faqs.answer: We recommend light, casual cotton clothing and comfortable sandals or sneakers. Don't forget sunglasses and sunscreen.

faqs.question: Is the tour suitable for pregnant women?
faqs.answer: Due to bumpy terrain during dune bashing, it is not recommended for pregnant women. However, we can arrange direct transfer to a scenic photo spot without off-road dune bashing upon request.

desert-safari-pvt-land-cruiser.about_description: Experience the ultimate VIP desert safari with your own dedicated private luxury Toyota Land Cruiser. Enjoy customized dune bashing intensity, private stops for golden hour sunset photography, and VIP seating at the Bedouin desert camp.
highlights: Sunset photo stop on high red dunes
Live Tanoura, Fire & Belly Dance shows
5-Star BBQ dinner buffet with live cooking

itinerary.title: Private hotel pickup in luxury Land Cruiser
Welcome at VIP Bedouin Desert Camp

faqs.question: How many people can fit in the private Land Cruiser?
faqs.answer: Our private Land Cruiser accommodates up to 6 passengers comfortably with seatbelts and air-conditioning.

faqs.question: Is BBQ dinner included in the private package?
faqs.answer: Yes, full access to the international BBQ buffet with vegetarian and non-vegetarian selections is included.

sky-44-ft-yacht-rental.about_description: Sail the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf aboard our luxury 44 ft motor yacht. Glide past Ain Dubai, JBR Beach, Atlantis The Palm, and Burj Al Arab with a professional captain and dedicated crew.
highlights: Cruising past Dubai Marina & JBR skyline
Stunning views of Ain Dubai & Atlantis The Palm
Photo opportunities at Burj Al Arab
Complimentary water, ice, and soft drinks

itinerary.title: Boarding at Dubai Marina Yacht Club
Cruise along Marina canal into Arabian Gulf
Pass Ain Dubai and JBR beachfront
Anchor near Atlantis The Palm for sunset
Return cruise into Dubai Marina lights

faqs.question: Can we bring our own food and beverages?
faqs.answer: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own snacks, catering, and drinks. We provide glassware, ice, and barbecue facilities upon request.

desert-safari-bus-pickup-drop.about_description: An economical, value-packed desert safari experience with designated centralized pickup points in Dubai and Sharjah. Enjoy dune bashing, camel riding, BBQ dinner buffet, and live stage shows.
highlights: AC bus transport from centralized points

faqs.question: Where are the centralized pickup locations?
faqs.answer: Pickup spots include Deira City Centre, Burjuman, Lulu Al Barsha, and Sahara Centre Sharjah.

camel-ride-in-dubai.about_description: Connect with authentic Arabian heritage through a scenic camel trek across tranquil desert dunes. Experience the peaceful silence of the desert as nomadic Bedouins have traveled for centuries.
highlights: Guided camel ride across golden dunes
Sunset photo stop atop red dunes
Learn about camel history & desert wildlife

itinerary.title: Mount camels and begin 45-min desert trek

faqs.question: Is camel riding safe for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, our camels are gentle, well-trained, and led by experienced Bedouin camel handlers.

dubai-desert-safari.about_description: The classic Dubai evening safari with hotel pickup, 4x4 dune bashing, camel rides, sandboarding, sunset views, and a full evening of entertainment with BBQ dinner at our desert camp.

faqs.question: What live shows are performed?
faqs.answer: Shows include the mesmerizing Tanoura spinning dance, fire eating/spinning show, and traditional belly dance.

vip-desert-safari-dubai.about_description: Elevate your desert safari with VIP treatment: skip the buffet lines with personalized waiter table service, premium stage-front seating, and priority dune bashing.

faqs.question: What is VIP table service?
faqs.answer: Instead of waiting in buffet lines, our waitstaff serves all appetizers, grilled BBQ dishes, and drinks directly to your reserved stage-side table.

overnight-desert-safari-dubai.about_description: Sleep under the twinkling Arabian stars in a cozy Bedouin tent. Includes evening safari, BBQ dinner, campfire under the stars, overnight tent stay, and a sunrise camel trek with freshly cooked Arabian breakfast.

itinerary.title: Wake up to desert sunrise & camel ride

faqs.question: Are sleeping bags and bedding provided?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide clean mattresses, pillows, fresh linens, and warm blankets inside your private tent.

vip-desert-safari-pvt-land-cruiser.about_description: The pinnacle of desert luxury: a private brand-new Land Cruiser for your party, coupled with stage-side VIP table service, gourmet BBQ dining, and priority access to all desert activities.

Private photo stop on virgin dunes

itinerary.title: Private VIP pickup from your door

faqs.question: Is shisha included with the VIP table?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary table shisha service is included with our VIP private package.
